title: Relationship to Local Security Policy and Other Policies
shall_text: The local agency may complement the CJIS Security Policy with a local policy, or the agency may develop their own stand-alone security policy; however, the CJIS Security Policy shall always be the minimum standard and local policy may augment, or increase the standards,… ...and local policy may augment, or increase the standards, but shall not detract from the CJIS Security Policy standards.

title: Relationship to Local Security Policy and Other Policies
shall_text: The agency shall develop, disseminate, and maintain formal, documented procedures to facilitate the implementation of the CJIS Security Policy and, where applicable, the local security policy.

title: Relationship to Local Security Policy and Other Policies
shall_text: The policies and procedures shall be consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidance.

title: CJIS Systems Agencies (CSA)
shall_text: The head of each CSA shall appoint a CJIS Systems Officer (CSO).

title: CJIS Systems Agencies (CSA)
shall_text: Such decisions shall be documented and kept current.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: Pursuant to The Bylaws for the CJIS Advisory Policy Board and Working Groups, the role of CSO shall not be outsourced.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: The CSO shall set, maintain, and enforce the following:

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: 1. Standards for the selection, supervision, and separation of personnel who have access to CJI.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: 2. Policy governing the operation of computers, access devices, circuits, hubs, routers, firewalls, and other components that comprise and support a telecommunications network and related CJIS systems used to process, store, or transmit CJI, guaranteeing the priority, confidentiality, integrity, and availability of service needed by the criminal justice community.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: a. Ensure appropriate use, enforce system discipline, and ensure CJIS Division operating procedures are followed by all users of the respective services and information.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: b. Ensure state/federal agency compliance with policies approved by the APB and adopted by the FBI.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: c. Ensure the appointment of the CSA ISO and determine the extent of authority to the CSA ISO.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: d. Ensure the designation of a Terminal Agency Coordinator (TAC) within each agency with device access to CJIS systems.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: e. Ensure each agency having access to CJI has someone designated as the Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: f. Ensure the Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities receives enhanced security awareness training (ref. Awareness and Training (AT)).

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: g. Approve access to FBI CJIS systems.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: h. Assume ultimate responsibility for managing the security of CJIS systems within their state and/or agency.

title: CJIS Systems Officer (CSO)
shall_text: i. Perform other related duties outlined by the user agreements with the FBI CJIS Division.

title: Contracting Agency (CA)
shall_text: A CA is an agency, whether a CJA, NCJA (public), or NCJA (private), that enters into an agreement with a private contractor subject to the CJIS Security Addendum, The Security and Management Control Outsourcing Standard for Non-Channelers, or the Security and Management Control Outsourcing Standard for Channeling. The CA entering into an agreement with a contractor shall appoint an Agency Coordinator.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: The AC shall be responsible for the supervision and integrity of the system, training and continuing education of employees and operators, scheduling of initial training and testing, and certification testing and all required reports by NCIC.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: The AC shall:

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 1. Understand the communications, records capabilities, and needs of the Contractor which is accessing federal and state records through or because of its relationship with the CGA.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 2. Participate in related meetings and provide input and comments for system improvement.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 3. Receive information from the CGA (e.g., system updates) and disseminate it to appropriate Contractor employees.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 4. Maintain and update manuals applicable to the effectuation of the agreement, and provide them to the Contractor.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 5. Maintain up-to-date records of Contractor’s employees who access the system, including name, date of birth, social security number, date fingerprint card(s) submitted, date security clearance issued, and date initially trained, tested, certified or recertified (if applicable).

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 6. Train or ensure the training of Contractor personnel. If Contractor personnel access NCIC, schedule the operators for testing or a certification exam with the CSA staff, or AC staff with permission from the CSA staff. Schedule new operators for the certification exam within six (6) months of assignment. Schedule certified operators for biennial re- certification testing within thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of certification. Schedule operators for other mandated class.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 7. The AC will not permit an untrained/untested or non-certified Contractor employee to access CJI or systems supporting CJI where access to CJI can be gained.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 8. Where appropriate, ensure compliance by the Contractor with NCIC validation requirements.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 9. Provide completed applicant fingerprint cards on each Contractor employee who accesses the system to the CJA (or, where appropriate, CSA) for criminal background investigation prior to such employee accessing the system.

title: Agency Coordinator (AC)
shall_text: 10. Any other responsibility for the AC promulgated by the FBI.

title: CJIS System Agency Information Secrurity Officer (CSA ISO)
shall_text: The CSA ISO shall:

title: CJIS System Agency Information Secrurity Officer (CSA ISO)
shall_text: 1. Serve as the security point of contact (POC) to the FBI CJIS Division ISO.

title: CJIS System Agency Information Secrurity Officer (CSA ISO)
shall_text: 2. Document technical compliance with the CJIS Security Policy with the goal to assure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of criminal justice information to the user community throughout the CSA’s user community, to include the local level.

title: CJIS System Agency Information Secrurity Officer (CSA ISO)
shall_text: 3. Document and provide assistance for implementing the security-related controls for the Interface Agency and its users.

title: CJIS System Agency Information Secrurity Officer (CSA ISO)
shall_text: 4. Establish a security incident response and reporting procedure to discover, investigate, document, and report to the CSA, the affected criminal justice agency, and the FBI CJIS Division ISO major incidents that significantly endanger the security or integrity of CJI.

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: Each Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities (i.e., LASO, ARSO, Security Point of Contact, etc.) shall:

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: 1. Identify who is using the CSA approved hardware, software, and firmware and ensure no unauthorized individuals or processes have access to the same.

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: 2. Identify and document how the equipment is connected to the state system.

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: 3. Ensure that personnel security screening procedures are being followed as stated in this policy.

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: 4. Ensure the approved and appropriate security measures are in place and working as expected.

title: Organizational Personnel with Security Responsibilities
shall_text: 5. Support policy compliance and ensure CSA ISO is promptly informed of security incidents.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: The FBI CJIS ISO shall:

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 1. Maintain the CJIS Security Policy.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 2. Disseminate the FBI Director approved CJIS Security Policy.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 3. Serve as a liaison with the CSA’s ISO and with other personnel across the CJIS community and in this regard provide technical guidance as to the intent and implementation of operational and technical policy issues.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 4. Serve as a point-of-contact (POC) for computer incident notification and distribution of security alerts to the CSOs and ISOs.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 5. Assist with developing audit compliance guidelines as well as identifying and reconciling security-related issues.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 6. Develop and participate in information security training programs for the CSOs and ISOs, and provide a means by which to acquire feedback to measure the effectiveness and success of such training.

title: FBI CJIS Division Information Security Officer (FBI CJIS ISO)
shall_text: 7. Maintain a security policy resource center (SPRC) on FBI.gov and keep the CSOs and ISOs updated on pertinent information.

title: State Compact Officer (SCO)
shall_text: Pursuant to the National Crime Prevention and Privacy Compact, each party state shall appoint a Compact Officer… ...Compact Officer who shall ensure that Compact provisions and rules, procedures, and standards established by the Compact Council are complied with in their respective state.

title: Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
shall_text: PII shall be extracted from CJI for the purpose of official business only.

title: Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
shall_text: Agencies shall develop policies, based on state and local privacy rules, to ensure appropriate controls are applied when handling PII extracted from CJI.

title: Policy Area 1: Information Exchange Agreements
shall_text: The information shared through communication mediums shall be protected with appropriate security safeguards.

title: Information Exchange
shall_text: Before exchanging CJI, agencies shall put formal agreements in place that specify security controls.

title: Information Exchange
shall_text: Information exchange agreements for agencies sharing CJI data that is sent to and/or received from the FBI CJIS shall specify the security controls and conditions described in this document.

title: Information Exchange
shall_text: Information exchange agreements shall be supported by documentation committing both parties to the terms of information exchange.

title: Monitoring, Review, and Delivery of Services
shall_text: As specified in the inter-agency agreements, MCAs, and contractual agreements with private contractors, the services, reports and records provided by the service provider shall be regularly monitored and reviewed.

title: Monitoring, Review, and Delivery of Services
shall_text: The CJA, authorized agency, or FBI shall maintain sufficient overall control and visibility into all security aspects to include, but not limited to, identification of vulnerabilities and information security incident reporting/response.

title: Monitoring, Review, and Delivery of Services
shall_text: The incident reporting/response process used by the service provider shall conform to the incident reporting/response specifications provided in this policy.

title: Managing Changes to Service Providers
shall_text: Any changes to services provided by a service provider shall be managed by the CJA, authorized agency, or FBI.

title: Managing Changes to Service Providers
shall_text: Evaluation of the risks to the agency shall be undertaken based on the criticality of the data, system, and the impact of the change.

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: a. Develop, document, and disseminate to: organizational personnel with access control responsibilities

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: 1. Agency-level access control policy that:

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: 2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and the associated access controls;

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: b. Designate organizational personnel with information security responsibilities to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the access control policy and procedures; and

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: c. Review and update the current access control:

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: 1. Policy annually and following any security incidents involving unauthorized access to CJI or systems used to process, store, or transmit CJI; and

title: POLICY AND PROCEDURES
shall_text: 2. Procedures annually and following any security incidents involving unauthorized access to CJI or systems used to process, store, or transmit CJI.

title: (1) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | AUTOMATED SYSTEM ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
shall_text: Support the management of system accounts using automated mechanisms including email, phone, and text notifications.

title: (2) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | AUTOMATED TEMPORARY AND EMERGENCY ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
shall_text: Automatically remove temporary and emergency accounts within 72 hours.

title: (3) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS
shall_text: Disable accounts within one (1) week when the accounts:

title: (3) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS
shall_text: (a) Have expired;

title: (3) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS
shall_text: (b) Are no longer associated with a user or individual;

title: (3) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS
shall_text: (c) Are in violation of organizational policy; or

title: (3) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS
shall_text: (d) Have been inactive for 90 calendar days.

title: (4) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | AUTOMATED AUDIT ACTIONS
shall_text: Automatically audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions.

title: (5) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | INACTIVITY LOGOUT
shall_text: Require that users log out when a work period has been completed.

title: (13) ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT | DISABLE ACCOUNTS FOR HIGH-RISK INDIVIDUALS
shall_text: Disable accounts of individuals within 30 minutes of discovery of direct threats to the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of CJI.

title: ACCESS ENFORCEMENT
shall_text: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

title: (14) ACCESS ENFORCEMENT | INDIVIDUAL ACCESS
shall_text: Provide automated or manual processes to enable individuals to have access to elements of their personally identifiable information.

title: INFORMATION FLOW ENFORCEMENT
shall_text: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems by preventing CJI from being transmitted unencrypted across the public network, blocking outside traffic that claims to be from within the agency, and not passing any web requests to the public network that are not from agency controlled or internal boundary protection devices (e.g., proxies, gateways, firewalls, or routers).

title: SEPARATION OF DUTIES
shall_text: a. Identify and document separation of duties based on specific duties, operations, or information systems, as necessary, to mitigate risk to CJI; and

title: SEPARATION OF DUTIES
shall_text: b. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

title: LEAST PRIVILEGE
shall_text: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

title: (1) LEAST PRIVILEGE | AUTHORIZE ACCESS TO SECURITY FUNCTIONS
shall_text: Authorize access for personnel including, security administrators, system and network administrators, and other privileged users with access to system control, monitoring, or administration functions (e.g., system administrators, information security personnel, maintainers, system programmers, etc.) to:

title: (1) LEAST PRIVILEGE | AUTHORIZE ACCESS TO SECURITY FUNCTIONS
shall_text: (a) Established system accounts, configured access authorizations (i.e., permissions, privileges), set events to be audited, set intrusion detection parameters, and other security functions; and

title: (1) LEAST PRIVILEGE | AUTHORIZE ACCESS TO SECURITY FUNCTIONS
shall_text: (b) Security-relevant information in hardware, software, and firmware.

title: (2) LEAST PRIVILEGE | NON- PRIVILEGED ACCESS FOR NONSECURITY FUNCTIONS
shall_text: Require that users of system accounts (or roles) with access to privileged security functionsorsecurity-relevantinformation(e.g.,auditlogs),usenon-privilegedaccountsor roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

title: (5) LEAST PRIVILEGE | PRIVILEGED ACCOUNTS
shall_text: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to privileged users.

title: (7) LEAST PRIVILEGE | REVIEW OF USER PRIVILEGES
shall_text: a. Reviews annually the privileges assigned to non-privileged and privileged users to validate the need for such privileges; and

title: (7) LEAST PRIVILEGE | REVIEW OF USER PRIVILEGES
shall_text: b. Reassign or remove privileges, if necessary, to correctly reflect organizational mission and business needs.

title: (9) LEAST PRIVILEGE | LOG USE OF PRIVILEGED FUNCTIONS
shall_text: Log the execution of privileged functions.

title: (10) LEAST PRIVILEGE | PROHIBIT NON-PRIVILEGED USERS FROM EXECUTING PRIVILEGED FUNCTIONS
shall_text: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions.

title: UNSUCCESSFUL LOGON ATTEMPTS
shall_text: a. Enforce a limit of five (5) consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a 15- minute time period; and

title: UNSUCCESSFUL LOGON ATTEMPTS
shall_text: b. Automatically lock the account or node until released by an administrator when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

title: SYSTEM USE NOTIFICATION
shall_text: a. Display a system use notification message to users before granting access to the system that provides privacy and security notices consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines and state that:

title: SYSTEM USE NOTIFICATION
shall_text: 1. Users are accessing a restricted information system;

title: SYSTEM USE NOTIFICATION
shall_text: 2. System usage may be monitored, recorded, and subject to audit;
